text:
anya: quick note 1 found a redaction/order bug in the python sample app. when REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug the transport logs headers before our redact hook runs, so Authorization shows up in local logs. repro on python sdk 0.9.2.

chris: can repro with the minimal sample app. run `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug python sample_app/main.py` and you'll see `DEBUG:urllib3.connectionpool:Sending headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer ...'}`. seems like middleware ordering in the transport.

sam: workaround: set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info in CI/dev until fixed. also set REDWOOD_REDACT_HEADERS=authorization,cookie as a guard. but that only works if redact runs before logging.

leo: i'll open a tiny python sdk PR to register redaction before http logging. also spotted a JS/OTEL issue: when sampling <1 some requests don't get x-request-id injected by our otel hook in the JS sample app. likely a separate ordering issue around span creation.

anya: on the Next.js sample I saw fetch not forwarding traceparent when using the Next runtime fetch wrapper. using globalThis.fetch works. probably our instrumentation doesn't patch Next's wrapper.

chris: suggestion: add an e2e in sample-apps that runs Next in dev mode, performs a call that routes through the SDK, and asserts outgoing request headers include traceparent and x-request-id. also assert debug logs do not leak Authorization.

leo: plan: python PR (ensure redact-before-log), js-sdk PR (force x-request-id injection even if span not sampled), sample-apps e2e (next fetch + traceparent). tagging devex/telemetry.

sam: QA checklist: 1) debug logs never print Authorization or cookie; 2) every outgoing request has x-request-id even when span not sampled; 3) traceparent forwarded with Next runtime fetch; 4) update sample-app README and onboarding note about REDWOOD_REDACT_HEADERS and debug logging risks.

anya: assigning: leo -> python PR, chris -> next e2e + quickstart blurb, sam -> README + release note. devex-bot, can you mark telemetry-integration as flaky until these land?

devex-bot: flaky label applied to telemetry-integration job (https://ci.internal/telemetry/4821).

chris: I'll also add a small CI sandbox job that runs sample-apps with REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug to catch regressions.

leo: PR references: python-sdk#2145, sample-apps#89, js-sdk#912. I'll paste the failing logs into the python PR after scrubbing.

sam: draft release note: "Fix: prevent debug logs from printing sensitive headers; ensure request ID propagation across runtimes; restore Next.js fetch instrumentation."

anya: thanks all. ping me if you need the raw logs to attach to PRs. :thumbsup:
